//: Applications licensed by this server. Add one block per app (copy the Vehicle SIM one).
//1: start.bat connects every app listed here; build-setup.bat builds the Setup.exe of one or all.
//2: serverUrl: the address the installed apps use to reach this server. Leave empty to use
//3: this PC's network address (fine inside the office). For customers outside, put the

//help.name: Shown in menus
//help.productCode: Product code in the portal (Products). Created automatically if missing, with Trial/Monthly/Yearly/Lifetime plans
//help.productName / keyPrefix: Used only when the product has to be created. keyPrefix: 2-6 capital letters, unique
//help.keyFormat: KSTK_KEY (typed key), LIC_FILE (.lic hardware file) or VBS_KEY (signed key string, like Vehicle SIM)
//help.repo: Folder of the app's source code
//help.installerScript: Inno Setup .iss (relative to repo). It must package publishDir and the config file
//help.setupOutput: Where the Setup.exe is written, relative to repo (default: the .iss folder + \Output). Setup.exe files stay with the app, never in this folder
//help.publishDir: Where the build goes (relative to repo); the .iss must take its files from here
//help.exeName: The app's .exe, used to find existing builds to update
//help.configFile: Settings file the app reads next to its .exe. A name ending in .dat is written encrypted (AES-256-GCM); .json is plain text
//help.configTargets: Extra places (relative to repo) to write the settings file, e.g. where the .iss picks it up
//help.installedDir: Optional: folder under Program Files where the app is installed on this PC, updated too
